questions.title: If Typhoon Noul makes landfall in mainland China during July 2026, in which province will it do so?
questions.background: Landfall refers to the cyclone's centre crossing the coastline, rather than areas experiencing its wind or rain.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : China's National Meteorological Centre's official landfall report, including reliable news coverage quoting that report. Resolution : Resolve to the province containing the reported location of Typhoon Noul's mainland China landfall during July 2026. Accepted Answer Format : The province's name.
questions.current_reasoning: Typhoon Noul (12th named storm of 2026) is still weeks from genesis as of June 24, 2026, targeting mid-to-late July. Compared with early July, the subtropical high shifts further north in late July, and 2026's intensifying El Nino plus CMA's April 2026 warning of northward-moving midsummer typhoons tilt probabilities further toward East China (Zhejiang and Fujian) alongside climatological leader Guangdong. Hainan and Guangxi retain meaningful South China Sea probabilities, while 8% is left for Shandong, Jiangsu, Shanghai, and Liaoning.

Promoting Maharashtra (0.10 -> 0.28), adding Gujarat (0.15) and Uttar Pradesh (0.11), trimming Himachal Pradesh (0.22 -> 0.17) and Uttarakhand (0.14 -> 0.09), and leaving 20% residual for Assam, Kerala, Bihar, J&K, West Bengal, and other states reflects both the live tally and 25 remaining days to August 5.

questions.background: Brendon McCullum currently coaches England's men's Test cricket team.

Justin Langer enters at #3 (0.13), appearing on virtually every July 12 shortlist (BBC headline, Sky Sports 'top of most lists', iNews, Telegraph, Independent) as a proven Ashes-winning disciplinarian already coaching in England (Manchester Super Giants). Surrey coach Gareth Batty rises slightly to 0.08 (BBC, Independent, iNews; close ties to ex-Surrey ECB bosses Gould and Thompson) and former England assistant/current Glamorgan coach Richard Dawson enters at #5 (0.07; prominently featured by BBC Sport and Daily Telegraph), replacing Marcus Trescothick (absent from July 12 shortlists) and Andrew Flintoff (whom BBC explicitly reported is 'not thought to be among the leading contenders' and who just took the Sydney Thunder BBL role). local_articles.snippet: Former India wicketkeeper-batter Dinesh Karthik has poured cold water on speculation linking Royal Challengers Bengaluru head coach Andy Flower with the vacant England Test coaching role, insisting the Zimbabwean's packed coaching commitments and existing IPL contract make such a move highly unlikely. {{^htLoading}} {{/htLoading}} While the England and Wales Cricket Board (ECB) is yet to announce Brendon McCullum's successor following his departure after the 1-2 home Test series defeat to New Zealand last month, Flower has emerged as one of the leading candidates. questions.title: Which month of 2026 will have the highest ICE arrest total in the data publicly available by August 26, 2026?
questions.background: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) carries out arrests as part of federal immigration enforcement.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Use government data supplied by ICE, as reported by The Associated Press. Resolution Date : Resolve to the calendar month of 2026 with the largest arrest total among the months covered by the latest ICE monthly figures publicly available by August 26, 2026. Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the month name only.
questions.current_reasoning: Associated Press reporting (April 25 and May 1, 2026) using ICE/Deportation Data Project figures shows nationwide ICE arrests peaked near 40,000 in December 2025 and remained 'nearly as high' in January 2026 (with detention peaking at ~72,000), before falling roughly 12% after the Minneapolis killings and leadership shake-up, with detention dropping to 58,000 by May 1. That effectively puts February, March, and April well below January's high-water mark. With DHS still scaling up interior enforcement capacity over summer—and with reporting lags making June more likely than July to be complete by August 26—January is the clear favorite (~56%), followed by June (~17%) and July (~15%) if a summer enforcement surge surpasses January's ~38k-40k pace.
